ranked_gates.label: Context-sensitive autonomy behavior
ranked_gates.why: It is the best first English-only policy probe because it can be tested with synthetic multi-turn examples, does not require regulated product facts, and does not alter call-control or broad classifier reachability.
ranked_gates.risk: Can still become manipulative or over-personalized if autonomy language adapts too aggressively to customer hesitation.
ranked_gates.next_action: Open a targeted policy probe that defines allowed and forbidden autonomy-preserving follow-up patterns before any runtime patch.
ranked_gates.review_question: Should context-sensitive autonomy be the first English product-policy gate to probe while still blocked from runtime promotion?

ranked_gates.label: Voicemail action-only behavior
ranked_gates.why: It is important for English call quality, but it is call-control/action behavior rather than phrase quality, so it should follow a smaller policy probe.
ranked_gates.risk: Could make the runtime take inappropriate same-loop actions after voicemail detection or blur message-taking versus selling behavior.
ranked_gates.next_action: Keep blocked until a call-control-specific checkpoint defines action-only voicemail behavior.
ranked_gates.review_question: Should voicemail behavior remain deferred behind the autonomy probe?

ranked_gates.label: Coverage knowledge-policy behavior
ranked_gates.why: Coverage and policy-knowledge responses risk unsupported regulated advice and need product/legal boundaries before runtime use.
ranked_gates.risk: Could imply insurance coverage, eligibility, or legal/financial advice without a reviewed knowledge policy.
ranked_gates.next_action: Keep blocked until a separate knowledge-policy checkpoint defines allowed facts, uncertainty handling, and escalation.
ranked_gates.review_question: Should coverage knowledge-policy stay behind a separate legal/product-knowledge gate?

ranked_gates.label: Customer-move classification outside selected non-refusal groups
ranked_gates.why: Broadening customer-move classification has the largest blast radius because it changes reachability across many runtime branches.
ranked_gates.risk: Could route customer turns into newly promoted behavior without enough evidence for each branch.
ranked_gates.next_action: Keep blocked until smaller policy gates provide clearer acceptance criteria for broader classifier reachability.
ranked_gates.review_question: Should broad classifier expansion remain last among the current English product-policy gates?
